semiconductor_relevance: High — Kubotek specializes in optical imaging systems for semiconductor inspection, which are critical for quality control in manufacturing.
summary: Kubotek develops advanced optical imaging (AOI) systems designed for high-resolution inspection across various semiconductor processes, from front-end to back-end. Their systems are capable of inspecting panel level packages and wafers with resolutions as fine as 0.5 to 1 μm, making them suitable for applications in organic EL, semiconductors, and μLEDs.
capabilities: High-resolution optical imaging systems for semiconductor inspection
Inspection systems for panel level packages (PLPs) and wafers
Ultra-high speed and high definition imaging technology
